title: Party XP and Level-Up Forecast
dataSources: Campaign sessions (`campaign:session`), NPC ledger (`npc:ledger`), loot drops (`loot:drop`), XP awards (`xp:award`).
app: Tabletop RPG telemetry — virtual-tabletop session logs (Roll20, Foundry VTT), campaign trackers (World Anvil), and XP / loot / NPC ledgers — streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=xp:award
| stats sum(xp) as total_xp, latest(next_level_xp) as needed by character
| eval to_go=needed-total_xp, pct=round(100*total_xp/needed,1)
| sort pct
description: Tracks each character's experience toward the next level and forecasts who is closest to levelling up.
value: A shared XP tracker keeps the table motivated and helps the game master pace encounters toward level milestones.
implementation: Ingest XP awards into `index=personal`; track progress to the next level per character.
visualization: Bar chart of XP progress to next level by character.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks each character's experience points and who is closest to levelling up.
